Vertical overflow behavior.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;hr&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px"><p style="margin:0 0 6px">Before the break.</p><hr style="border:none;border-top:2px solid #d1d5db;margin:8px 0"><p style="margin:0">After the break.</p></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Before the break.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt;After the break.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>overflow-y</b> = <b>keyword</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>hr { overflow-y: keyword; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of box-sizing?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>content-box</code></li><li>B. <code>solid2</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>border-box</code></li><li>D. <code>auto2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6070">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6071 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6072">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6072" data-page="6072" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5195"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 6072 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5195 — dialog × align-items</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dialog</span> <span class="badge prop">align-items</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">align-items</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dialog&gt;</code> — a native dialog box: modal when shown with showmodal(), non-modal when shown with show(). }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of border-style?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>none</code></li><li>B. <code>hidden</code></li><li>C. <code>always</code></li><li>D. <code>banana2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6071">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6072 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6073">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6073" data-page="6073" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5196"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 6073 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5196 — s × grid-template-areas</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">s</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-template-areas</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-template-areas</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;s&gt;</code> — marks text that is no longer accurate or relevant (not a strikethrough for style). Shorthand: font-style font-variant font-weight font-size/line-height font-family.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dfn&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><dfn style="font-style:italic"><b>semantics</b></dfn>: the meaning carried by markup, not just its appearance.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;dfn&gt;semantics&lt;/dfn&gt;: the meaning of markup.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dfn { font: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of z-index?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>auto</code></li><li>B. <code>solid2</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>integer</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6073">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6074 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6075">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6075" data-page="6075" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5198"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 26</span><span>Page 6075 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5198 — sup × letter-spacing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sup</span> <span class="badge prop">letter-spacing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">letter-spacing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sup&gt;</code> — superscript text (rendered above the baseline). }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of flex-direction?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>row-reverse</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>row</code></li><li>C. <code>auto9</code></li><li>D. <code>banana</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6076">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6077 / 8000 · Practice 26</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6078">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6078" data-page="6078" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5201"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6078 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5201 — iframe × forced-color-adjust</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">iframe</span> <span class="badge prop">forced-color-adjust</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">forced-color-adjust</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;iframe&gt;</code> — embeds another html page in a nested browsing context. as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:2px solid #8b949e;border-radius:6px;width:250px;padding:8px;background:#fff"><h1 style="font-size:14px;margin:2px 0 0">Hello from an iframe</h1><div style="font-size:10px;color:#8b949e">separate document, own DOM</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;iframe srcdoc=&quot;&lt;h1&gt;Hello from an iframe&lt;/h1&gt;&quot; width=&quot;260&quot; height=&quot;70&quot; sandbox=&quot;allow-same-origin&quot;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>forced-color-adjust</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>iframe { forced-color-adjust: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of align-items?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>stretch</code></li><li>B. <code>center</code></li><li>C. <code>never</code></li><li>D. <code>always</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6077">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6078 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6079">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6079" data-page="6079" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5202"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6079 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5202 — input × list-style-position</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">input</span> <span class="badge prop">list-style-position</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">list-style-position</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;input&gt;</code> — the most versatile form control: text, email, number, date, file, checkbox, radio, range, color, search and more. Where the marker sits: inside or outside the box.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;input&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><form style="display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:12px;max-width:250px"><label style="display:grid;gap:3px"><b>Full name</b><input style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></label><label style="display:grid;gap:3px"><b>Email</b><input type="email" style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></label><label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><input type="checkbox" checked> Newsletter</label><button style="justify-self:start;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 16px">Send</button></form></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form&gt; &lt;label&gt;Full name &lt;input type=&quot;text&quot; name=&quot;name&quot; required autocomplete=&quot;name&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Email &lt;input type=&quot;email&quot; name=&quot;email&quot; required&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Age &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; name=&quot;age&quot; min=&quot;0&quot; max=&quot;120&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; name=&quot;news&quot; checked&gt; Newsletter&lt;/label&gt; &lt;button&gt;Send&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>list-style-position</b> = <b>inside</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>input { list-style-position: inside; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “CSS rules that apply to the current document.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;style&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;s&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;optgroup&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;header&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6104">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6105 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6106">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6106" data-page="6106" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5229"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6106 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5229 — figure × line-height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">figure</span> <span class="badge prop">line-height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">line-height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;figure&gt;</code> — self-contained media (image, diagram, code) with an optional caption. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A major block of navigation links.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;kbd&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;nav&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;colgroup&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h4&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6107">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6108 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6109">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6109" data-page="6109" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5232"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6109 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5232 — em × color-scheme</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">em</span> <span class="badge prop">color-scheme</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">color-scheme</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;em&gt;</code> — marks stress emphasis — change in meaning if removed. Limits an element&#x27;s side effects (layout, paint, size, style) to its subtree.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;th&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><table style="border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px"><tr><th style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;padding:4px 10px">Name</th><th style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;padding:4px 10px">Score</th></tr><tr><th style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 10px;background:#fafafa">Ali</th><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 10px">92</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 10px;background:#eff6ff;font-weight:600">Top scorer: Ali</td></tr></table></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Embeds another HTML page in a nested browsing context.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;frameset&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;iframe&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;details&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;option&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6128">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6129 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6130">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6130" data-page="6130" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5253"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6130 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5253 — bdi × min-width</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">bdi</span> <span class="badge prop">min-width</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">min-width</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;bdi&gt;</code> — isolates text so its direction does not affect surrounding text. The lower limit of the width.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;bdi&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Hello <bdi dir="auto" style="background:#fef9c3;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px">مرحبا</bdi> world — isolated, layout-safe</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Hello &lt;bdi dir=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;مرحبا&lt;/bdi&gt; world&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>min-width</b> = <b>0</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>bdi { min-width: 0; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A named parameter passed to an &lt;object&gt; resource.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;basefont&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;span&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;param&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6129">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6130 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6131">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6131" data-page="6131" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5254"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6131 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5254 — dd × padding-right</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dd</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-right</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-right</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dd&gt;</code> — the description (details) for a term in a description list. Inner space at the right.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dd&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;color:#4b5563;margin-left:18px">World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet. <i>(dd)</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;Web&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet.&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-right</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dd { padding-right: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section for user input, submitted to a server.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;dir&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;i&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;form&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;legend&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6130">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6131 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6132">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6132" data-page="6132" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5255"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6132 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5255 — canvas × border-spacing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">canvas</span> <span class="badge prop">border-spacing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-spacing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;canvas&gt;</code> — a bitmap drawing surface controlled by the 2d api or webgl. width=&quot;200&quot; height=&quot;80&quot;&gt;&lt;/canvas&gt; &lt;script&gt; const x = document.querySelector(&quot;#c&quot;).getContext(&quot;2d&quot;); x.fillStyle = &quot;#4285f4&quot;; x.fillRect(10, 10, 80, 40); x.fillStyle = &quot;#34a853&quot;; x.fillRect(100, 20, 80, 40); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-spacing</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>canvas { border-spacing: length; usemap=&quot;#island&quot; alt=&quot;Island map&quot;&gt; &lt;map name=&quot;island&quot;&gt; &lt;area shape=&quot;rect&quot; coords=&quot;0,0,120,80&quot; href=&quot;/beach&quot; alt=&quot;Beach&quot;&gt; &lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Sep&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;$14,100&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt; &lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-template-columns</b> = <b>fit-content</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>table { grid-template-columns: fit-content; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “What gestures the browser handles (scroll/zoom) vs the app.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>display</code></li><li>B. <code>flex-wrap</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>touch-action</code></li><li>D. <code>text-wrap</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6198">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6199 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6200">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6200" data-page="6200" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5323"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6200 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5323 — s × text-underline-offset</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">s</span> <span class="badge prop">text-underline-offset</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-underline-offset</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;s&gt;</code> — marks text that is no longer accurate or relevant (not a strikethrough for style). required&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Age &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; name=&quot;age&quot; min=&quot;0&quot; max=&quot;120&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; style=&quot;background:#eef2ff&quot;&gt;&lt;/colgroup&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>col { margin: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Pause or resume a running animation.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>animation-play-state</code></li><li>B. <code>border-top</code></li><li>C. <code>justify-items</code></li><li>D. <code>forced-color-adjust</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6207">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6208 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6209">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6209" data-page="6209" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5332"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6209 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5332 — font × padding-block</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">font</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-block</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-block</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;font&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: font (obsolete). Logical top+bottom padding.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;font&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-family:serif;color:#ef4444;font-size:13px">Legacy: <font> is dead — use CSS</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;font face=&quot;Arial&quot; color=&quot;red&quot;&gt;text&lt;/font&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-block</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>font { padding-block: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Which part of the timeline the animation plays in (new).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>border-collapse</code></li><li>B. <code>font-family</code></li><li>C. <code>backdrop-filter</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>animation-range</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6208">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6209 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6210">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6210" data-page="6210" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5333"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6210 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5333 — acronym × float</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">acronym</span> <span class="badge prop">float</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">float</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;acronym&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: acronym (obsolete). Floats the element left/right; text wraps around it.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;acronym&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:13px"><abbr title="World Wide Web" style="text-decoration:underline dotted;cursor:help">WWW</abbr> — use <abbr> now</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;acronym title=&quot;World Wide Web&quot;&gt;WWW&lt;/acronym&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>float</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>acronym { float: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Which box the transform coordinates use (content-box / border-box / fill-box / view-box).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>outline-offset</code></li><li>B. <code>font-style</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>transform-box</code></li><li>D. <code>mask-image</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6209">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6210 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6211">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6211" data-page="6211" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5334"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6211 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5334 — nextid × visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">nextid</span> <span class="badge prop">visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;nextid&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: nextid (obsolete). Show or hide an element while keeping its space.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;nextid&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af">No longer in the spec — just use links.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;nextid href=&quot;part2.html&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>visibility</b> = <b>collapse</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>nextid { visibility: collapse; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Independent scale (composes with transform).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>clear</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>scale</code></li><li>C. <code>font-stretch</code></li><li>D. <code>shape-outside</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6210">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6211 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6212">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6212" data-page="6212" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5335"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6212 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5335 — html × align-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">html</span> <span class="badge prop">align-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">align-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;html&gt;</code> — the root element of every html document. Overrides align-items for one item.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;html&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">&lt;html&gt; &rarr; &lt;head&gt; + &lt;body&gt;</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;html lang=&quot;en&quot;&gt; &lt;head&gt;...&lt;/head&gt; &lt;body&gt;...&lt;/body&gt; &lt;/html&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>align-self</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>html { align-self: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Position along the offset-path (0%–100%).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>bottom</code></li><li>B. <code>font-optical-sizing</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>offset-distance</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style-type</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6211">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6212 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6213">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6213" data-page="6213" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5336"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6213 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5336 — script × grid-row</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">script</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-row</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-row</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;script&gt;</code> — embeds or references executable javascript. Spans grid rows (shorthand: row-start / row-end).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;script&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;background:#0d1117;color:#7ee787;padding:10px;border-radius:6px">console.log("hi"); → "hi"</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;script src=&quot;app.js&quot; defer&gt;&lt;/script&gt; &lt;script&gt; console.log(&quot;hi&quot;); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-row</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>script { grid-row: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by tag name (p, a, h1…).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>element</code></li><li>B. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>C. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>D. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6212">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6213 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6214">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6214" data-page="6214" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5337"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6214 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5337 — aside × font-size</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">aside</span> <span class="badge prop">font-size</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-size</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;aside&gt;</code> — content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote). The size of the text.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;aside&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:#fff3e0;border:1px solid #ffcc80;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;width:230px"><b style="font-size:12px">Did you know?</b><br><span style="font-size:12px">An <b>aside</b> box — related but optional.</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;aside&gt; &lt;h3&gt;Did you know?&lt;/h3&gt; &lt;p&gt;HTML5 added 40+ new elements.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/aside&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-size</b> = <b>px</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>aside { font-size: px; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches elements that HAVE the attribute.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>B. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>D. <code>:lang(code)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6213">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6214 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6215">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6215" data-page="6215" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5338"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6215 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5338 — figcaption × text-align</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">figcaption</span> <span class="badge prop">text-align</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-align</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;figcaption&gt;</code> — the caption for a &lt;figure&gt;. The browser adds vertical space around it automatically.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;This is a paragraph of text.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>word-break</b> = <b>break-all</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>p { word-break: break-all; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is under the pointer.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:empty</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>D. <code>::before</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6215">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6216 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6217">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6217" data-page="6217" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5340"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6217 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5340 — summary × background-image</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">summary</span> <span class="badge prop">background-image</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-image</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;summary&gt;</code> — the visible caption of a &lt;details&gt; disclosure. Real-time image effects on the element (blur, brightness, grayscale…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;u&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">My name is <u>Ali</u>. — underlined, no meaning</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;My name is &lt;u&gt;Ali&lt;/u&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>filter</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>u { filter: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The sole child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>::marker</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:only-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6217">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6218 / 8000 · Practice 27</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6219">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6219" data-page="6219" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5342"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 27</span><span>Page 6219 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5342 — data × counter-reset</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">data</span> <span class="badge prop">counter-reset</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">counter-reset</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;data&gt;</code> — a machine-readable value behind human-readable text. Stacking order of positioned elements (higher = on top).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;bdo&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><bdo dir="rtl" style="background:#fee2e2;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px">12:30</bdo> — forced RTL rendering</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;bdo dir=&quot;rtl&quot;&gt;12:30 → 03:21&lt;/bdo&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>z-index</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>bdo { z-index: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Which styles apply before start / after end.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>border-color</code></li><li>B. <code>place-self</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>animation-fill-mode</code></li><li>D. <code>color-scheme</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6365">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6366 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6367">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6367" data-page="6367" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5490"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6367 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5490 — img × flex-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">img</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;img&gt;</code> — embeds an image. “Matches by unique id.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>#id</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>:target</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6371">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6372 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6373">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6373" data-page="6373" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5496"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6373 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5496 — strike × caret-color</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">strike</span> <span class="badge prop">caret-color</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">caret-color</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;strike&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: strike (obsolete). Extra clearance around a shape-outside shape.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;basefont&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px">body { font-family: Verdana; font-size: 14px; } — that replaced <basefont></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;basefont face=&quot;Verdana&quot; size=&quot;2&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>shape-margin</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>basefont { shape-margin: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches an element in a state.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>B. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:</code></li><li>D. <code>~</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6373">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6374 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6375">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6375" data-page="6375" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5498"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6375 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5498 — del × pointer-events</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">del</span> <span class="badge prop">pointer-events</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">pointer-events</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;del&gt;</code> — marks text removed from the document (change tracking). Whether the element can be the target of mouse/pointer events.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;del&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px"><del style="color:#9ca3af">Old price: $99</del> → <b>$79</b> <small>(deleted 2026-09-10)</small></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;del datetime=&quot;2026-09-10&quot;&gt;Old price: $99&lt;/del&gt; → $79</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>pointer-events</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>del { pointer-events: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Focus via keyboard (not mouse click).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>B. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>C. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>D. <code>::first-letter</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6374">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6375 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6376">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6376" data-page="6376" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5499"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6376 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5499 — meta × user-drag</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">meta</span> <span class="badge prop">user-drag</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">user-drag</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;meta&gt;</code> — machine-readable metadata about the document (encoding, viewport, description, authors). Whether the element can be dragged (legacy, mostly images).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;meta&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">charset=UTF-8<br>viewport=width=device-width<br>description="A huge HTML+CSS reference."</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;meta charset=&quot;UTF-8&quot;&gt; &lt;meta name=&quot;viewport&quot; content=&quot;width=device-width, initial-scale=1&quot;&gt; &lt;meta name=&quot;description&quot; content=&quot;A huge HTML+CSS reference.&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>user-drag</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>meta { user-drag: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>B. <code>:checked</code></li><li>C. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>D. <code>::placeholder</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6375">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6376 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6377">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6377" data-page="6377" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5500"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6377 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5500 — section × animation-direction</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">section</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-direction</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-direction</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;section&gt;</code> — a thematic grouping of content, typically with a heading. Forward / reverse / alternate playback.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;section&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border-left:4px solid #4285f4;padding:8px 12px;background:#f0f6ff;width:250px"><b style="font-size:13px">Shipping</b><br><span style="font-size:12px;color:#444">A thematic <b>section</b> of the page</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;section&gt; &lt;h2&gt;Shipping&lt;/h2&gt; &lt;p&gt;We ship worldwide.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/section&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-direction</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>section { animation-direction: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The n-th child OF ITS TAG type (ignores other tags).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6376">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6377 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6378">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6378" data-page="6378" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5501"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6378 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5501 — address × offset-path</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">address</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-path</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-path</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;address&gt;</code> — contact information for the author/owner of an article or page. Move the element along an SVG path (motion path).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;address&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-style:italic;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;background:#fafbfc"><a href="#" style="color:#1a56db">hi@example.com</a> · Cairo, Egypt</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;address&gt; &lt;a href=&quot;mailto:hi@example.com&quot;&gt;hi@example.com&lt;/a&gt; · Cairo, EG &lt;/address&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>offset-path</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>address { offset-path: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “No children at all (not even text).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::after</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:empty</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6377">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6378 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6379">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6379" data-page="6379" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5502"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6379 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5502 — h5 × margin-top</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h5</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-top</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-top</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h5&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 5 (h1 = highest). Distance above the element (outside its border).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h5&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 5</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h5&gt;Heading level 5&lt;/h5&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-top</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h5 { margin-top: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Like :is but with ZERO specificity.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6378">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6379 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6380">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6380" data-page="6380" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5503"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6380 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5503 — blockquote × border</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">blockquote</span> <span class="badge prop">border</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;blockquote&gt;</code> — a section quoted from another source. Shorthand: width + style + color for the whole border.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;blockquote&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border-left:4px solid #6b7280;margin-left:8px;padding-left:12px;color:#374151;font-size:13px;font-style:italic">“The power to affect the world comes from the ability to connect people.”</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;blockquote cite=&quot;https://www.w3.org/&quot;&gt;The power to affect the world...&lt;/blockquote&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border</b> = <b>1px solid #d1d5db</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>blockquote { border: 1px solid #d1d5db; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Form control usable or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>~</code></li><li>C. <code>::backdrop</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6379">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6380 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6381">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6381" data-page="6381" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5504"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6381 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5504 — i × clear</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">i</span> <span class="badge prop">clear</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">clear</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;i&gt;</code> — text in an alternate voice or mood (technical terms, foreign phrases, ship names). Prevents floats on one or both sides (moves the box below them).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;i&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">The word <i>rendezvous</i> is borrowed from French.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;The word &lt;i&gt;rendezvous&lt;/i&gt; is borrowed from French.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>clear</b> = <b>both</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>i { clear: both; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The placeholder is currently visible (field empty).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::first-letter</code></li><li>B. <code>*</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li><li>D. <code>:hover</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6380">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6381 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6382">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6382" data-page="6382" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5505"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6382 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5505 — q × content-visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">q</span> <span class="badge prop">content-visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">content-visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;q&gt;</code> — a short inline quotation (rendered with quotation marks). Skip rendering of off-screen subtrees (auto + contain-intrinsic-size).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;q&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">As the docs say, <q>HTML is the skeleton</q>.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;As the docs say, &lt;q cite=&quot;https://w3.org/&quot;&gt;HTML is the skeleton&lt;/q&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>content-visibility</b> = <b>visible</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>q { content-visibility: visible; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Element&#x27;s language matches the code.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::placeholder</code></li><li>B. <code>#id</code></li><li>C. <code>:active</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:lang(code)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6381">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6382 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6383">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6383" data-page="6383" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5506"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6383 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5506 — code × flex-grow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">code</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-grow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-grow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;code&gt;</code> — a fragment of computer code. How much an item grows to fill spare space (ratio).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;code&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Use <code style="font-family:monospace;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">display: grid</code> for layouts.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Use &lt;code&gt;display: grid&lt;/code&gt; for layouts.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-grow</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>code { flex-grow: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Any depth descendant.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>B. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li><li>D. <code>:only-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6382">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6383 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6384">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6384" data-page="6384" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5507"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6384 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5507 — bdi × grid-column</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">bdi</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-column</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-column</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;bdi&gt;</code> — isolates text so its direction does not affect surrounding text. Spans grid columns (shorthand: col-start / col-end).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;bdi&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Hello <bdi dir="auto" style="background:#fef9c3;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px">مرحبا</bdi> world — isolated, layout-safe</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Hello &lt;bdi dir=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;مرحبا&lt;/bdi&gt; world&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-column</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>bdi { grid-column: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Generated content INSIDE the start of the element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>element</code></li><li>B. <code>:</code></li><li>C. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::before</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6383">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6384 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6385">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6385" data-page="6385" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5508"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6385 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5508 — dd × font-weight</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dd</span> <span class="badge prop">font-weight</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-weight</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dd&gt;</code> — the description (details) for a term in a description list. The thickness of the text (100–900 or keywords).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dd&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;color:#4b5563;margin-left:18px">World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet. <i>(dd)</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;Web&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet.&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-weight</b> = <b>100–900</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dd { font-weight: 100–900; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The first line of a block.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>B. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>D. <code>:not(sel)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6384">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6385 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6386">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6386" data-page="6386" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5509"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6386 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5509 — canvas × text-align-last</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">canvas</span> <span class="badge prop">text-align-last</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-align-last</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;canvas&gt;</code> — a bitmap drawing surface controlled by the 2d api or webgl. &lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Sep&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;$14,100&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt; &lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>backdrop-filter</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>table { backdrop-filter: none; Wait this long before the transition starts.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;applet&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af">Java applets: extinct. Games are now <canvas>/WebGL/JS.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;applet code=&quot;Game.class&quot; width=200 height=100&gt;&lt;/applet&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transition-delay</b> = <b>time</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>applet { transition-delay: time; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of content-visibility?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>visible</code></li><li>B. <code>banana</code></li><li>C. <code>solid2</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>auto</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6391">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6392 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6393">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6393" data-page="6393" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5516"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6393 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5516 — a × transform</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">a</span> <span class="badge prop">transform</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transform</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;a&gt;</code> — creates a hyperlink to a page, a section, a file, an email, or a phone number. Move/rotate/scale/skew the element (GPU-friendly, doesn&#x27;t reflow).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;a&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;display:grid;gap:4px"><a href="#" style="color:#2563eb">W3Schools HTML <span style="font-size:10px">↗ (target=_blank)</span></a><a href="#" style="color:#2563eb">Jump to #contact</a><a href="#" style="color:#2563eb">Email us (mailto:)</a></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;a href=&quot;https://w3schools.com/html/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; rel=&quot;noopener&quot;&gt;W3Schools HTML&lt;/a&gt; &lt;a href=&quot;#contact&quot;&gt;Jump to contact&lt;/a&gt; &lt;a href=&quot;mailto:hi@example.com&quot;&gt;Email us&lt;/a&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transform</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>a { transform: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of transform-style?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>preserve-3d</code></li><li>B. <code>always</code></li><li>C. <code>banana2</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>flat</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6392">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6393 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6394">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6394" data-page="6394" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5517"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6394 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5517 — link × height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">link</span> <span class="badge prop">height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;link&gt;</code> — links an external resource, most commonly a stylesheet. Sets the height of an element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;link&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center"><span style="width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4285f4,#34a853)"></span><code style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px">style.css → linked</code></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;link rel=&quot;stylesheet&quot; href=&quot;style.css&quot;&gt; &lt;link rel=&quot;icon&quot; href=&quot;logo.svg&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>height</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>link { height: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of flex-wrap?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>wrap</code></li><li>B. <code>banana</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>nowrap</code></li><li>D. <code>solid2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6393">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6394 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6395">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6395" data-page="6395" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5518"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6395 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5518 — div × padding</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">div</span> <span class="badge prop">padding</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;div&gt;</code> — a neutral block-level container with no semantic meaning. Space inside the border (all four sides).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;div&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#fafbfc;width:220px"><b style="font-size:13px">&lt;div class="card"&gt;</b><br><span style="font-size:12px;color:#57606a">a layout box with no meaning</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;div class=&quot;card&quot;&gt; &lt;h2&gt;Card title&lt;/h2&gt; &lt;p&gt;Card text&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/div&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding</b> = <b>12px</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>div { padding: 12px; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of flex-basis?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>length</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>auto</code></li><li>C. <code>solid2</code></li><li>D. <code>auto2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6394">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6395 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6396">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6396" data-page="6396" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5519"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6396 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5519 — main × border-radius</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">main</span> <span class="badge prop">border-radius</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-radius</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;main&gt;</code> — the dominant, unique content of the document. Rounds the corners (all four in one declaration).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;main&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:2px solid #4285f4;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#f8fbff;width:260px"><b style="color:#1a56db;font-size:12px">MAIN CONTENT</b><br><span style="font-size:12px">Everything the user came here for lives inside <b>&lt;main&gt;</b>.</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;main&gt; &lt;article&gt;...the post...&lt;/article&gt; &lt;/main&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-radius</b> = <b>50%</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>main { border-radius: 50%; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of grid-auto-flow?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>column</code></li><li>B. <code>auto2</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>row</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6395">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6396 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6397">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6397" data-page="6397" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5520"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6397 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5520 — h4 × inset</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h4</span> <span class="badge prop">inset</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">inset</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h4&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 4 (h1 = highest). Shorthand for top/right/bottom/left (one declaration).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h4&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:16.0px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 4</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h4&gt;Heading level 4&lt;/h4&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>inset</b> = <b>0</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h4 { inset: 0; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of font-variant?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>normal</code></li><li>B. <code>auto9</code></li><li>C. <code>banana</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>small-caps</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6396">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6397 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6398">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6398" data-page="6398" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5521"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6398 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5521 — pre × flex-direction</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">pre</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-direction</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-direction</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;pre&gt;</code> — preformatted text where whitespace and line breaks matter (code, diagrams). The main axis direction of a flex container.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;pre&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><pre style="background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;font-size:11px;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;margin:0">function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }</pre></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code&gt;function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-direction</b> = <b>row</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>pre { flex-direction: row; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of text-align?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>center</code></li><li>B. <code>auto2</code></li><li>C. <code>never</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>justify</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6397">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6398 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6399">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6399" data-page="6399" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5522"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6399 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5522 — strong × column-gap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">strong</span> <span class="badge prop">column-gap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">column-gap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;strong&gt;</code> — marks text of strong importance, seriousness or urgency. Space between columns (grid columns / flex columns).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;strong&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><strong>Warning:</strong> This action cannot be undone.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Warning:&lt;/strong&gt; This action cannot be undone.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>column-gap</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>strong { column-gap: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of text-wrap?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>auto</code></li><li>B. <code>banana2</code></li><li>C. <code>auto9</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>balance</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6398">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6399 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6400">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6400" data-page="6400" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5523"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6400 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5523 — cite × place-content</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">cite</span> <span class="badge prop">place-content</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-content</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;cite&gt;</code> — the title of a creative work (book, film, song, page).
