Enable/disable kerning between letter pairs.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;samp&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">If you see <samp style="font-family:monospace;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">404 Not Found</samp>, the page is missing.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;If you see &lt;samp&gt;404 Not Found&lt;/samp&gt;, the page is missing.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-kerning</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>samp { font-kerning: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of direction?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>ltr</code></li><li>B. <code>rtl</code></li><li>C. <code>banana</code></li><li>D. <code>solid2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6400">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6401 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6402">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6402" data-page="6402" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5525"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6402 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5525 — rp × text-underline-offset</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">rp</span> <span class="badge prop">text-underline-offset</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-underline-offset</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;rp&gt;</code> — fallback parentheses for ruby annotations in browsers without ruby support. as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:240px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:14px;font-size:13px"><b>Are you sure?</b><div style="margin-top:10px;text-align:right"><button style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f9fafb;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;margin-right:6px;font-size:12px">Cancel</button><button style="border:none;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px">OK</button></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dialog id=&quot;dlg&quot;&gt; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Legacy/obsolete element: Base Font (obsolete).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;p&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;basefont&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;track&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;head&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6458">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6459 / 8000 · Practice 28</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6460">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6460" data-page="6460" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5583"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 28</span><span>Page 6460 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5583 — input × transform-style</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">input</span> <span class="badge prop">transform-style</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transform-style</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;input&gt;</code> — the most versatile form control: text, email, number, date, file, checkbox, radio, range, color, search and more. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Automatic hyphenation of long words.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>quotes</code></li><li>B. <code>margin</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>hyphens</code></li><li>D. <code>flex-shrink</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6499">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6500 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="../volumes/vol-14.html#p6501">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <script> (function(){ var pageEl = document.querySelector('.page[data-page]'); if(!pageEl) return; // hash scroll function goHash(){ if(location.hash){ var t = document.querySelector(location.hash); if(t) t.scrollIntoView(); } } window.addEventListener('load', goHash); window.addEventListener('hashchange', goHash); // keyboard document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.target.matches('input,textarea')) return; if(e.key === 'ArrowRight'){ var n = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="next"]'); if(n) n.click(); } if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ var p = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="prev"]'); if(p) p.click(); } }); // jump (every page has one) var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.jump-input'); for(var bi = 0; return; } var vol = Math.ceil(n / 500); location.href = 'vol-' + String(vol).padStart(2, '0') + '.html' + '#p' + n; }); })(boxes[bi]); } })(); </script> </body> </html>
